_comment: Canonical listing store. IMPORTANT: statuses reflect VERIFICATION state, not desirability. Nothing may be promoted to status 'match' until its active-on-market status has been confirmed against a live source (see README 'Verification gate'). Search-engine snippets are NOT a valid source of listing status - they index sold listings with 'For Sale' in the title for years.

dataQuality.note: Redfin became reachable from this environment on the 2026-07-26 run (www.redfin.com returns 200; Zillow, Realtor.com, Homes.com, Movoto and Trulia are still blocked). Search results are read from the server-rendered /stingray/api/gis payload embedded in each filtered search page, and every candidate is then confirmed against its own live detail page. Pool status comes from the MLS POOL_PRIVATE_YN field on that page, not from listing prose - which is what caught 4810 Robledo Dr, 1200 W El Largo Dr and 3961 Seven Ridges Rd, all of which mention pools in text but report hasPrivatePool=false.

searchCoverage.method: Redfin zip-scoped filtered searches, results parsed from the embedded GIS payload
searchCoverage.finding: Across all three target cities there are exactly two active 5BR+/3BA+ homes with a private pool on 2.5+ acres under $1.5M, and both are in Placerville. Shingle Springs and Rescue currently have ZERO listings at any bed count that combine a private pool, 2.5+ acres and a sub-$1.5M price with 5+ bedrooms — their pool-and-acreage inventory tops out at 4 bedrooms.

listings.blurb: The clean match. Custom estate on a 5.05-acre homesite in the gated Greenstone Country community — mature oaks, rock outcroppings, seasonal pond. Five to six bedrooms and four baths across 3,885 sqft: three bedrooms on the main level, primary suite upstairs with balcony, fireplace and bar area, plus two more bedrooms. Fenced built-in gunite pool with sweep, 4-car garage and a detached 2-car carport. HOA covers the community pool, clubhouse, lake and courts. Horses allowed. On market 138 days at $975K — the only property in the whole search that clears every hard criterion with room left in the budget.
listings.notes: Verified 2026-07-26 against the live Redfin detail page: mlsStatus Active, searchStatus 1, priceInfo.amount 975000, POOL_PRIVATE_YN = Yes with features Built-In / Pool Sweep / Fenced / Gunite Construction. Price, bed/bath count and sqft independently corroborated by a second source. MLS 226059973 is a 2026 listing number.

listings.agent: Amir Cackovic · eXp Realty of California
listings.blurb: Meets the criteria on paper, but it is not a single-family house. A fully remodelled 10.27-acre compound marketed as a wedding venue / short-term-rental business, with an operating pro-forma attached to the listing. The bedroom and bath counts are the total across three separate residences — a main home plus two detached guest suites, sleeping 16. County records put the main house at just 1,336 sqft. The pool is genuinely spectacular: 150,000 gallons, described as one of the largest residential pools in El Dorado County, with its own adjacent bathroom. Sold January 2024 for $1,125,000; on market 67 days at the top of your budget. Worth a look if a multigenerational or income-producing estate appeals — not if you want one house with five bedrooms in it.
listings.notes: Verified 2026-07-26 against the live Redfin detail page: mlsStatus Active, priceInfo.amount 1500000, POOL_PRIVATE_YN = Yes (Built-In), lot 447,361 sqft = 10.27 acres. PRICE DISAGREEMENT, reported rather than resolved: a second source shows this address listed at $1,390,000. That figure appears to trace to an older commercial listing (MLS 224040487, Windermere/LoopNet, 2024) rather than the current MLS 226093241. The live 2026 listing page fetched today says $1,500,000; treat $1.39M as unconfirmed. Note also the sqft conflict — the MLS reports 2,025 sqft while county records show 1,336 sqft for the main structure; neither figure covers all three residences.
